name: Retained front
summary: Retain the original front, double garage, fountain and main stair; add rear family living and a subordinate side floor.
retained: Original main facade, entrance, main stair, double garage, fountain, main roof form and chimney; most original walls.
main_changes: 3.8 m single-storey rear living and dining addition
Subordinate side floor with two bedrooms, one metre rear projection
Original east rooms form the principal suite
Ground guest suite and one loft guest room with separate workspace
Four outside parking spaces and an 8 × 3.5 m pool
compromise: The retained garage is approximately 4.95 m wide inside: a tight double garage for compact cars. Vehicle choice and door-opening clearance need review.
planning: Lower front impact than the current proposal; side gap, rear depth, dormer size, garage siting and neighbour effects still require assessment.
status: Concept under development; dimensions from reconstructed model
